system.description:
[Trigger: Action] Used simultaneously with your "Basic Magic Attack". If "Basic Magic Attack" succeeds, the target becomes [State That Does Not Exist In The Scene]. This effect is removed at the end of the round, and afterward, the target receives [Dazed]. Once per scenario. This effect is called "Labyrinth Seal".

Old Branch of the Spirited Away [Core Material] (240G) + Cedar Staff (400G) + Madder Charm (140G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 11] (120G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (580G)
